models.title: Models
models.about: One setup for the kit and all its projects. Providers first — API connections; then roles in each capability: a provider and a model, and with the «+» button, fallbacks in order.
models.load_failed: The model setup did not load
models.scope: Applies to every project on the machine ({n}); a project has no model setup of its own. File:
models.leftover: The .env of project «{name}» still has model variables — they no longer apply, remove them: {keys}
models.saved: Model setup saved — it applies to every project
models.ping_save_first: Save your changes first — the saved setup is what gets checked
models.providers_about: A provider is an API connection: address, key and how many requests it takes. A work gateway, a home llama.cpp, an embeddings service — each one its own provider. Models are picked in roles.
models.providers_empty: No providers yet. Add the first one — or create it right in a role while picking the model.
models.list_failed: The provider gave no model list — type the name by hand
models.p_drop_used: Provider «{name}» is used in roles ({n}). Delete it together with those backends?
models.key_set: key saved — type a new one to replace it
models.p_width_hint: How many requests this server takes. 0 — not declared: the provider shares the run's overall cap.
models.p_parallel_hint: Untick for a slow fallback: it waits its turn in the chain and does not get a stream of tasks.
models.template_bad: not JSON — the field will not be saved
models.cap_about.llm: Roles of the language model. Engine roles are called by tasks: parsing and theses, planner, critic, answers. Each role has a primary backend and fallbacks in order: if the primary does not answer, the request goes to the next one.
models.cap_about.ocr: Scan recognition by a vision model. While the role has no backend, a scan honestly stays unparsed: a text model does not refuse an image, it makes things up. A fallback may be a different model.
models.cap_about.embeddings: Vectors for searching the base. A fallback is used only with the same model: another model's vectors live in another space, and swapping silently breaks search. No backend — search goes by words.
models.role_id_hint: The role's name for the engine and tasks
models.role_drop_ask: Delete role «{name}» together with its backends?
models.role_empty_engine: No backends — this role's tasks go to «{name}».
models.role_empty: No backends — pick a provider and a model.
models.thinking_hint: Faster without reasoning, but theses embellish and the critic goes blind (PRJ-A measurement 21.09.2026).
models.new_provider_about: A new provider — it will also appear in the «Providers» tab.
models.context_hint: How many tokens this model takes at this provider. Empty — not declared: the engine does not drop big requests in advance.
models.url_hint: If the embeddings or recognition service lives at another address than the provider's API.
models.enabled_hint: A switched-off backend stays in the chain, but no requests go to it.
models.other_space: another model — will not join the ring
models.other_space_hint: An embeddings fallback is used only with the same model as the primary.
models.run_about: Shared by all roles. «At once» is the run's cap: you can write «auto» — then the sum of provider widths is used; a number cuts it.
models.measure_hint: Growing batches of requests to each provider: how many it really takes at once. The result is in the console.
models.run_debug_hint: The agent run stops at the first error instead of going on through the cards. For finding a cause, not for work.
models.ping_failed: The check did not answer — the panel is unreachable or was interrupted.
models.role_empty_default.llm: No backends — the agent has nothing to run on: pick a provider and a model.
models.role_empty_default.ocr: No backends — scan recognition is off. Name the model explicitly: a guessed name gives not a refusal but a coherent fabrication.
models.role_empty_default.embeddings: No backends — semantic search is off.
